summary: Iteration 17 — hybrid orderbook delta filter + smart trailing TP. Backend-only pytest suite (15 tests) all PASSED. Verified: /api/hybrid/orderbook returns numeric buyWall/sellWall/deltaLong/deltaShort for BTC/ETH/SOL with deltaLong≈1/deltaShort; hybrid_power.trail_stop_offset math matches spec (0.30->None, 0.40->0.05, 0.90->0.45, 1.40->0.95); /api/hybrid config exposes all 11 new keys; obDeltaFilter toggles+persists; server-side clamps apply (999->100 for deltas, 9->5 for pwr/trail pct, 999->100 for trailLock); defaults restore cleanly; /api/bot/status and /api/tokens remain 200 during a 30s SIM run; no Traceback/hybrid error in backend.err.log. critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1200 lines — consider splitting hybrid processing, trailing, and config clamp logic into modules for maintainability.

trail_stop_offset uses max(be, peak-step+be); note this means SL only advances in step increments (e.g. peak 0.85 still yields 0.40; peak 0.90 -> 0.45). That matches spec but user should be aware SL is discrete, not continuous.

Run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_hybrid_trailing.py -v -o addopts=''.
